module: Common core of the "one shot" race wizards: from a descriptor, createConfigurator() returns an object that holds the selection (level, track/"middle", settings, vehicle), summarizes it for the interface (getConfiguration), provides the best scores and starts the race. Used by quickraceConfigurator and lightrunnerConfigurator; a modder can use it to create a new selection wizard.
usage:
local cfg = require("ge/extensions/oneshotRace/oneshotRaceCore").createConfigurator(descripteur)
cfg.selectLevel("glow_city"); cfg.selectMiddle("glow_city", "maPiste"); cfg.selectVehicle("sbr", "powerglow"); cfg.start()
notes: Descriptor contract: logTag (string); gridBackendName (ui_gridSelector backend that is the source of levels and tracks); routeDataKey (key in the router's route data); vehicleRestrictionMode (optional, passed to ui_vehicleSelector_general.setVehicleRestrictionMode during the vehicle route); defaultSettings() -> table; onSelectMiddle(settings, middle); onUpdateSetting(settings, key, value, middle) (optional); extraSettingKeys (optional, keys accepted in addition to those of defaultSettings); buildLevelSummary(level); buildMiddleSummary(middle, selection) (must contain a settings field); getHighscoreKey(selection, middle) -> {levelName, scenarioName, configKey} or nil; start(level, middle, settings, vehicleFile, selection); getDefaultSelection(selector) (optional, called once on first entry into the wizard, returns {levelName, middleName, vehicle = {model, config}} or nil).
In selectVehicle, an unknown config is replaced by the model's default config (default_pc).
updateSetting rejects a key that exists neither in the current settings nor in extraSettingKeys. A setting whose initial value is nil (like seed) must therefore be listed in extraSettingKeys.
start() fails (false) if level, track or vehicle model are not selected.
The first three route-entry hooks remove any vehicle restriction; only onWizardVehicleRouteEnter applies vehicleRestrictionMode.

todNames.desc: Names of the proposed times of day (night, sunrise, morning, earlyNoon, noon, lateNoon, afternoon, evening, sunset), 1-based (tod = 3 corresponds to morning).

createConfigurator.desc: Creates a configurator bound to a descriptor. The returned object (Cfg) has: getSelection, selectLevel(levelName), selectMiddle(levelName, middleName), selectVehicle(model, config, additionalData), updateSetting(key, value), toggleShowLapRecords(), getHighscores(), getConfiguration(), onWizardRouteEnter / onWizardLevelRouteEnter / onWizardMiddleRouteEnter / onWizardVehicleRouteEnter(context, toRoute, fromRoute, data), start().

descriptor.desc: Descriptor following the contract described in the notes.

returns.desc: Configurator (Cfg). getConfiguration returns {level, middle, vehicle, highscores, showLapRecords, isDisabled, todOptionKeys}; isDisabled is true until level, track and vehicle are all set.
